gaps.gap: update_knowledge_profile takes only description, serviceArea, hours, policies, tone, signature and allowPrices. It can't add, change or remove a service or its price, and it can't change Words to use or Words to avoid, though the profile has services[] (max 50, {name, description, price|null}) and wordsToUse/wordsToAvoid (up to 30, 60 characters each) and the form edits all of them. Every text field is text(n), which is min(1), and the worker's str() drops empty strings, so no field can be cleared. Nothing else in coverage.ts or screen-actions offers knowledge.profile_update. The settings map still promises 'what you offer' and the How to 'Add a service and its price'.
gaps.fix: Fixed: update_knowledge_profile takes the whole services list (name, about it, price), words to use and to avoid, and an empty text field clears it. The card lists only what changes and refuses when nothing would. packages/core/src/assistant/tools.ts:600-608: add services: z.array({name: text(120), description: z.string().trim().max(500).default(''), price: z.string().trim().max(120).nullable()}).max(50) ('the whole list, as Business profile → Services shows it'), plus wordsToUse and wordsToAvoid as z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(60)).max(30). Change the six text fields to z.string().trim().max(n), where '' clears the field. apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-settings-business.ts:577 and 612-620: read the text fields with a helper that keeps '' (typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : undefined), not str(), and pass services, wordsToUse and wordsToAvoid into `changed`.
